newsitem.title: UK: Sharelink offers frequent trader discounts.
newsitem.headline: Sharelink offers frequent trader discounts.

text.p: Discount brokerage Sharelink said on Thursday it was offering special terms to active share traders with the launch of its frequent traders club.

The broker, owned by Charles Schwab of the U.S., said the club would cost 60 stg a year to join and would offer a flat fee of 16.50 stg for telephone trades of any size, dropping to 15.00 for trades booked through a direct personal computer link.
Sharelink chairman David Jones said the frequent traders club "will provide an unrivalled home for people's investments and will help them manage these more effectively."
